mapper.select: /* SQL ID : QbnkQstnDAO.profQbnkQstnList 설 명 : 교수문항복사문제은행문항목록조회 */ WITH PROF_USER AS ( -- 기준 과목의 담당교수(PROF) 단건 SELECT USER_ID FROM ( SELECT USER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SBJCT_ADM_SEQNO ASC) AS RNUM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM WHERE SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) WHERE RNUM = 1 ), PROF_SBJCT AS ( -- 그 교수가 PROF로 등록된 모든 과목 SELECT SBJCT.SBJCT_ID, PU.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM ON ADM.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' JOIN PROF_USER PU ON PU.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID WHERE SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' ) SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT QSTN.QBNK_QSTN_ID AS QSTN_ID , CASE WHEN CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID IS NULL THEN CTGR.CTGRNM ELSE PARENT.CTGRNM END AS UP_QBNK_CTGRNM , CASE WHEN CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE CTGR.CTGRNM END AS QBNK_CTGRNM , (SELECT CDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'QSTN_RSPNS_TYCD' AND CD = QSTN.QSTN_RSPNS_TYCD) AS QSTN_RSPNS_TYNM , QSTN.QSTN_TTL , (SELECT CDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'QSTN_DFCTLV_TYCD' AND CD = QSTN.QSTN_DFCTLV_TYCD) AS QSTN_DFCTLV_TYNM , CTGR.CTGR_SEQNO , CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID , NVL(CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID, CTGR.QBNK_CTGR_ID) AS GRP_QBNK_CTGR_ID -- 상위/하위 분류를 묶어서 정렬하기 위한 그룹핑 키 FROM TB_LMS_QBNK_CTGR CTGR JOIN TB_LMS_QBNK_QSTN QSTN ON CTGR.QBNK_CTGR_ID = QSTN.QBNK_CTGR_ID AND QSTN.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON CTGR.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' AND SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' JOIN PROF_SBJCT ADM ON ADM.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND ADM.USER_ID = QSTN.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID AND USR.USER_ID_STSCD = 'APRV_CMPTN' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_QBNK_CTGR PARENT -- 상위 카테고리명 조회용 자기조인 ON PARENT.QBNK_CTGR_ID = CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID WHERE CTGR.DELYN = 'N' AND (CTGR.QBNK_CTGR_ID = #{qbnkCtgrId} OR CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID = #{qbnkCtgrId}) ) A ORDER BY A.GRP_QBNK_CTGR_ID DESC, CASE WHEN A.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.CTGR_SEQNO

/* SQL ID : QbnkQstnDAO.qbnkQstnSelect 설 명 : 문제은행문항조회 */ SELECT QSTN.QBNK_QSTN_ID , QSTN.QBNK_CTGR_ID , (SELECT QBNK_CTGR_ID FROM TB_LMS_QBNK_CTGR WHERE QBNK_CTGR_ID = CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID AND DELYN = 'N') AS UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID , QSTN.QSTN_SEQNO , QSTN.QSTN_TTL , DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(QSTN.QSTN_CTS, 4000, 1) AS QSTN_CTS , QSTN.QSTN_RSPNS_TYCD , QSTN.CRANS_TYCD , QSTN.QSTN_DFCTLV_TYCD , CTGR.CTGRNM , (SELECT CTGRNM FROM TB_LMS_QBNK_CTGR WHERE QBNK_CTGR_ID = CTGR.UP_QBNK_CTGR_ID) AS UP_CTGRNM , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = CTGR.USER_ID AND USER_ID = CTGR.USER_ID) AS USERNM FROM TB_LMS_QBNK_QSTN QSTN JOIN TB_LMS_QBNK_CTGR CTGR ON QSTN.QBNK_CTGR_ID = CTGR.QBNK_CTGR_ID AND CTGR.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = CTGR.SBJCT_ID AND SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE QSTN.DELYN = 'N' AND QSTN.QBNK_QSTN_ID = #{qbnkQstnId}
/* SQL ID : QbnkQstnDAO.qbnkNextQstnSeqnoSelect 설 명 : 문제은행다음문항순번조회 */ SELECT NVL(MAX(QSTN_SEQNO), 0) + 1 FROM TB_LMS_QBNK_QSTN WHERE QBNK_CTGR_ID = #{qbnkCtgrId} AND DELYN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : QbnkQstnDAO.qbnkQstnDelNSeqnoModify 설 명 : 문제은행문항미삭제순번수정 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_QBNK_QSTN QBNK_QSTN SET QBNK_QSTN.MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , QBNK_QSTN.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() , QBNK_QSTN.QSTN_SEQNO = QBNK_QSTN.QSTN_SEQNO - 1 WHERE QBNK_QSTN.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT QBNK_CTGR_ID, QSTN_SEQNO FROM TB_LMS_QBNK_QSTN WHERE QBNK_QSTN_ID = #{qbnkQstnId} ) BASE WHERE QBNK_QSTN.QBNK_CTGR_ID = BASE.QBNK_CTGR_ID AND QBNK_QSTN.QSTN_SEQNO > BASE.QSTN_SEQNO )
